text:
maria: quick idea thread: propose an append-only activation ledger ("apply watermark") + operator escrow for targeted, auditable rollbacks in airgapped/on-prem installs. goal: let operators backout specific activations without Redwood holding private keys. thoughts?

sam: short Q: is watermark the source of truth or just an audit trail? :thinking:

maria: source of truth for the local operator. sidecar enforces activation only when a valid watermark exists. preflight writes prepare watermark, commit watermark after migrations/checks.

leo: concern: partial backout could leave dependent components or DB migrations in a bad state. how avoid half-applies?

anya: require two-phase for stateful changes: prepare -> migrate -> commit. rollbacks only target commit checkpoints. otherwise include compensating migrations in bundle.

maria: for stateless artifacts use atomic swap (rename/symlink). for DB require idempotent migrations or explicit compensators.

sam: operator-escrow = customer-held keys? adds key mgmt burden though.

maria: yes. keys remain with customer. support threshold signing (e.g., 2-of-3) for backout markers. Redwood provides offline helper tooling to assemble signed markers; private keys never leave customer control.

leo: how to stop replay or unauthorized backouts?

maria: markers include target seq, expiry window, and nonce. sidecar enforces signer ACL and nonce monotonicity; it stores applied backouts in the ledger to prevent replay.

anya: need component-level dependency manifests in bundles so local preflight can compute a dependency graph offline and reject unsafe backouts.

maria: rule: backouts only allowed for topologically safe cut sets. provide a small CLI validator to compute graph and emit rejections.

sam: retention/audit: how long keep watermarks?

leo: keep watermarks + backouts in JSONL audit log N days; archive to customer store. exportable for compliance.

maria: default behavior: manual operator-initiated backouts. opt-in automated revert only for stateless changes and gated by strict policies.

anya: recovery if operator loses escrow key? multi-party manual recovery with offline attestations + approvals. document as emergency playbook.

maria: next steps: i'll draft RFC with schema (watermark fields + signature), sidecar API (writeWatermark, verifyBackout, applyBackout, listWatermarks), sample dependency manifest, and offline signing cookbook. tagging @leo @anya for review.

ops-bot: Created RFC #2026: apply-watermark-and-operator-escrow (https://go/repo/rfcs/2026) :white_check_mark: 

maria: thanks, will post link when draft is ready.
